How to use this calculator

  1. Enter weight, height.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How anorexic bmi is calculated

BMI=weight(kg)/height(m)². Adult BMI under 16 is a very low screening value; eating-disorder diagnosis depends on clinical assessment, not a BMI threshold alone. At 45 kg and 1.70 m, BMI is 15.6, a result that warrants careful medical context rather than self-diagnosis.

BMI=weight(kg)/height(m)²; BMI alone cannot diagnose an eating disorder.
A worked example

At 45 kg and 1.70 m, BMI is 15.6, a result that warrants careful medical context rather than self-diagnosis.

Assumptions & useful context

BMI cannot diagnose anorexia or any eating disorder.

Health calculations are estimates for education. They cannot diagnose a condition or replace a clinician’s assessment. Individual needs vary, especially during pregnancy, illness and growth.

CDC: Adult BMI categories and calculation

Frequently asked questions

Does a low BMI prove anorexia nervosa?

No. An eating disorder can occur at many body sizes and requires professional assessment.

What should I do if the number worries me?

Contact a qualified healthcare professional; urgent symptoms need urgent care.
